title.text: Private Seine Cruise with Champagne on a Small Boat

pills.label: 1.5 hours
pills.pop_html: 1.5 hours with the boat to yourselves: past the Eiffel Tower, Pont Alexandre III, Musée d’Orsay, the Louvre and Pont Neuf to Notre-Dame and back.📍 2 Port de Javel Haut: 75015 Paris, by the Statue of Liberty replica. There is no sign at the pier. The captain can drop you near the Louvre at the end if you ask.

pills.label: Champagne included
pills.pop_html: A bottle of Champagne and water are included.

pills.label: Bring your own food
pills.pop_html: Bring your own food and drinks. Only the Luxury boat (5 to 8 people) has a table.

pills.label: Up to 8 people
pills.pop_html: Standard boat: €399 for 1 to 4 (no table, 280 kg total passenger weight limit). Luxury boat: €520 for 5 to 6, €590 for 7, €660 for 8.

pills.label: Bluetooth speaker
pills.pop_html: A Bluetooth speaker for your own music. Pets are welcome.

pills.label: EN, FR, PL captain
pills.pop_html: The captain speaks English, French and Polish, and reviewers say they take photos for you along the way.

best_for.pick_html: for the most-reviewed private boat in Paris (410 reviews, 5.0/5) at the lowest price, with Champagne included.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a table for 2 to 4: only the larger Luxury boat has one.

items.q: How much is it for our group?
items.a: €399 for 1 to 4 people on the Standard boat. The Luxury boat is €520 for 5 or 6, €590 for 7 and €660 for 8.

items.q: Can we bring food and drinks?
items.a: Yes. A bottle of Champagne and water are included, and you can bring your own food and drinks; only the Luxury boat has a table.

items.q: Where do we meet the boat?
items.a: 2 Port de Javel Haut, 75015 Paris, by the small Statue of Liberty replica. There is no sign, so save the captain’s number.
The captain waits up to 60 minutes, but the cruise is shortened by the time you are late.
Yes, for free up to 24 hours before.

title.text: Private Small-Boat Cruise with Rosé & Macarons

pills.label: 1.5 h · evening 20:00
pills.pop_html: 1.5 hours, with an evening departure at 20:00. In summer it can finish before dark, which leaves time for dinner afterwards.📍 2 Port de Javel Haut: 75015 Paris, the same pier as #1.

pills.label: Rosé & macarons
pills.pop_html: Rosé, Evian water and macarons served during the cruise. You can still bring any other food or drinks.

pills.label: Eiffel Tower photo stop
pills.pop_html: A 10-minute photo stop at the Eiffel Tower, then past the Grand Palais, Pont Alexandre III, Musée d’Orsay and the Louvre to Notre-Dame.

pills.label: Max 6 on a 10-seat boat
pills.pop_html: A boat that seats 10, limited to 6 passengers: room to spread out even when full.

pills.label: Kids welcome
pills.pop_html: 👶 Kids: welcome, with life jackets in all sizes♿ Wheelchair: not suitable for wheelchair users

pills.label: EN or FR captain
pills.pop_html: The captain commentates in English or French. For a proposal, mention it in the booking notes.

best_for.pick_html: for a proposal or an anniversary: rosé and macarons on board and a photo stop at the Eiffel Tower.
best_for.skip_html: if it is just the two of you on a budget: it is €490 per boat even for 2.

items.q: Is it good for a proposal?
items.a: Yes, its reviews read like a list of proposals and anniversaries. Mention it in the booking notes: one reviewer wrote that the captain knew exactly when to give them privacy at the Eiffel Tower.
Rosé wine, Evian water and macarons. You can bring any other food or drinks.
Yes, children are welcome and there are life jackets in all sizes. It is not suitable for wheelchair users.
The evening cruise leaves at 20:00 from 2 Port de Javel Haut. In summer it can finish before dark.

items.q: What if the weather is bad?
items.a: If it is cancelled for bad weather, you can reschedule or get a full refund.

title.text: 2-Hour Private Pontoon Boat Cruise with Skipper-Guide

pills.label: 2 hours
pills.pop_html: 2 full hours on a private modern pontoon boat: 30 minutes more than most private boats at the same price. Part of it is the ride up to the Eiffel Tower.📍 100 Quai du Président Roosevelt: 92130 Issy-les-Moulineaux, just outside Paris to the south-west. One reviewer struggled to find it, so plan your journey.

pills.label: Skipper-guide
pills.pop_html: Your skipper doubles as the guide, with facts and anecdotes in English or French, rated 4.8/5 for guiding. Photo stops at the best backdrops.

pills.label: Bring your own drinks
pills.pop_html: No drinks are included: bring your own. Reviewers bring Champagne, wine, charcuterie and pastries.

pills.label: Lounge seating
pills.pop_html: A modern pontoon boat with lounge seating and a Bluetooth speaker.

pills.label: Up to 6 people
pills.pop_html: €490 for up to 6 people.

best_for.pick_html: for the longest cruise for the money: 2 hours with a skipper-guide for €490.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a central pier: it leaves from Issy-les-Moulineaux, outside Paris.

items.a: 2 hours, 30 minutes more than most private boats at the same price. Part of that is the ride up to the Eiffel Tower.
100 Quai du Président Roosevelt in Issy-les-Moulineaux, just outside Paris to the south-west. Allow extra travel time.
No, bring your own. Reviewers bring Champagne, wine, charcuterie and pastries.
Yes: the skipper is also the guide, in English or French, rated 4.8/5 for guiding.
Yes, for free up to 24 hours before.

title.text: Private Seine Cruise with a Live Guide & Soft Drinks

pills.label: 1.5 to 2+ hours
pills.pop_html: Three routes: Initiation (1.5 hours, €490 for up to 6), Exploration (2 hours) and Conquête, the longest. The longer options are seasonal: in mid-November only Initiation had dates.📍 Port de Javel: 15th arrondissement (plus code R7XJ+Q66 on the listing).

pills.label: Live guide 5.0/5
pills.pop_html: Guiding rated 5.0/5, the best guiding score on this list. One guide timed the cruise for the Eiffel Tower sparkle at 21:00 and again at 22:00.

pills.label: Soft drinks included
pills.pop_html: Soft drinks are included; food is not.

pills.label: French or English
pills.pop_html: The guide speaks French or English.

pills.label: Shelter from rain
pills.pop_html: One group on a rainy day wrote that they stayed protected from the rain and wind.

best_for.pick_html: if the commentary matters most: guiding rated 5.0/5, timed for the Eiffel Tower sparkle.
best_for.skip_html: if you want the most reviews or the best value: 65 reviews, and value rated 4.7/5.

items.a: Rated 5.0/5 for guiding across 65 reviews. One guide timed the route so the group saw the Eiffel Tower sparkle at 21:00 and 22:00.
Initiation (1.5 hours, €490 for up to 6) runs all year. Exploration (2 hours) and Conquête are seasonal; in mid-November the 2-hour option’s next date was in January.
Soft drinks and the live guide. Food and tips are not included.
No: reviewers booked it for a bachelor party and a team outing too.
Yes, for free up to 24 hours before.

title.text: Private Electric Pontoon Cruise from the Louvre (6 People)

pills.label: 1.5 hours
pills.pop_html: 1.5 hours from the 1st arrondissement: a loop past Pont Neuf, Île de la Cité and Île Saint-Louis, then down to Musée d’Orsay, Pont Alexandre III and the Eiffel Tower.📍 14 Quai François Mitterrand: 75001 Paris, a short walk from the Louvre.

pills.label: Wheelchair accessible
pills.pop_html: ♿ Wheelchair: ✓ listed as wheelchair-accessible, the only one on this list

pills.label: Quiet electric boat
pills.pop_html: A quiet electric pontoon with a guide and a Bluetooth speaker.

pills.label: Bring your own food
pills.pop_html: Bring your own food and drinks: one family had breakfast on board.

pills.label: Minimum 6 people
pills.pop_html: €80 per person, minimum 6, so €480 even if fewer of you go. Seats are split between the bow and the stern.

best_for.pick_html: for a group of 6 staying in central Paris, or anyone who needs a wheelchair-accessible private boat.
best_for.skip_html: if you are fewer than 6: you pay for 6 anyway, and the seats are split bow and stern.

items.a: 14 Quai François Mitterrand, 75001 Paris, a short walk from the Louvre: the most central pier on this list.
€80 per person with a minimum of 6, so €480 for a group of 6 even if fewer of you go.
Yes, it is the only listing on this page marked wheelchair-accessible.
Not all around one table: the seats are split between the front and the back of the boat.
Yes, for free up to 24 hours before.

title.text: VIP Limousine Boat for up to 12 with Champagne & Macarons

pills.label: 1.5 hours
pills.pop_html: 1.5 hours from the central pier by the Louvre, the same as #5.📍 14 Quai François Mitterrand: 75001 Paris.

pills.label: Up to 12 people
pills.pop_html: The only boat on this list for groups larger than 8. €1,250 works out at about €104 each for 12.

pills.label: Heated, convertible roof
pills.pop_html: A floating lounge with large sofas and tables, a convertible roof, heating in winter and a toilet on board.

pills.label: Champagne & macarons
pills.pop_html: 1 bottle of Champagne, macarons and soft drinks are included. Food boards and extra bottles are sold on board; no outside food or drinks.Macarons can’t be guaranteed for bookings made less than 24 hours ahead (you get €20 back instead).

pills.label: Captain + host-guide
pills.pop_html: A captain and a host-guide in French, English or Spanish.

best_for.pick_html: for birthdays, bachelorette parties and family groups of 9 to 12, or a private cruise in winter.
best_for.skip_html: for a small group or a picnic: €1,250 per boat, and no outside food or drinks.

items.a: Up to 12. At €1,250 that is about €104 each for a full boat.
Yes, plus heating and a convertible roof, so it works in any season.

items.q: Can we bring our own drinks?
items.a: No. One bottle of Champagne, macarons and soft drinks are included; extra bottles and food boards are sold on board.

items.q: Which languages does the host speak?
items.a: French, English or Spanish.
Yes, for free up to 24 hours before.
